working_definition: Small group (73 cells) labelled with the whole adult Malpighian tubule organ (Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00005725), found in gut and heart analyses; cells are tubule cells.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Specialized cell of the adult Malpighian tubules.

justification: The authors' term is the organ (not a cell). The most general adult cell-level term for tubule cells in FBbt is adult specialized Malpighian tubule cell (parent of principal, stellate etc.). Tubule stem cells would not be covered, hence low confidence.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Malpighian tubule of the adult. It is very similar to that of the larva, except that the initial segment of the anterior tubule is much smaller in the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ term, not a cell term.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00005733 (broad, low confidence); curator may prefer to hold.
